title: MedAnon
summary: A rule-driven FHIR R4 de-identification engine that de-identifies and pseudonymizes clinical data for research, compliance, and data sharing. Its analytics service includes an optional module that uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a Metadata schema to generate synthetic FHIR Patient and Condition resources preserving multivariate correlations.
